# NEXUS CLI Reference

Every command that `nexus.cli.build_parser()` registers, with its arguments and its transport from `nexus/cli_contract.py`. The guide, the exit codes, and the JSON envelopes are in [docs/cli.md](cli.md).

## Global Options

| Argument | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | — | — | Emit JSON output |
| `--truncate` | — | — | Truncate long text fields (head 10 + tail 10 lines) |

## Transports

| Transport | Opens | Commands |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `http` | The NEXUS API only | `inspect slot`, `inspect chunks`, `inspect chunk`, `inspect incubator`, `inspect characters`, `inspect places`, `inspect factions`, `load`, `continue`, `retry`, `undo`, `regenerate`, `clear`, `lock`, `unlock`, `model --set`, `model --clear` |
| `database` | A slot database directly | `jobs`, `inspect-turn`, `prune-manifests`, `tags audit`, `model`, `trait-audit`, `retrograde-packet`, `retrograde-apply-expansion`, `retrograde-embed-history`, `record-revelation`, `faction-audit`, `faction-manifest`, `faction-apply`, `character-manifest`, `character-apply`, `place-manifest`, `place-apply`, `retrograde-seed-candidates --slot` |
| `local_operator` | This machine's processes, logs, runtime home, usage ledger, model artifacts, local files, or provider credentials | `up`, `down`, `restart`, `status`, `logs`, `home`, `doctor`, `usage`, `receipts`, `window-replay`, `models lock`, `models verify`, `models plan`, `models fetch`, `retrograde-seed-candidates`, `retrograde-expand-seeds`, `backfill-review-packet`, `model --list` |

Under the remote profile: `up` uses `http`; `status` uses `http`.

## Commands

### `nexus up`

Start the NEXUS runtime (gateway + enabled services).

Transport: `local_operator`. Under the remote profile: `http`.

| Argument | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--slot` | `SLOT` | — | Active slot (1-5) |
| `--foreground` | — | — | Stay attached: stream logs, supervise, tear down on Ctrl+C |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | — | Path to nexus.toml (default: $NEXUS_HOME/nexus.toml, else NEXUS_RUNTIME_CONFIG, else the checkout's nexus.toml) |

### `nexus down`

Stop managed runtime services.

Transport: `local_operator`.

| Argument | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `service` | `service` (optional) | — | Stop a single service by name |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | — | Path to nexus.toml (default: $NEXUS_HOME/nexus.toml, else NEXUS_RUNTIME_CONFIG, else the checkout's nexus.toml) |

### `nexus restart`

Restart managed runtime services.

Transport: `local_operator`.

| Argument | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `service` | `service` (optional) | — | Restart a single service by name |
| `--slot` | `SLOT` | — | Active slot (1-5) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | — | Path to nexus.toml (default: $NEXUS_HOME/nexus.toml, else NEXUS_RUNTIME_CONFIG, else the checkout's nexus.toml) |

### `nexus window-replay`

Replay a run's recorded prompt windows under candidate settings.

Transport: `local_operator`.

| Argument | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--run` (required) | `RUN` | — | Generation session id from the usage ledger |
| `--day` | `DAY` | — | UTC ledger day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: current UTC day) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | — | Candidate nexus.toml (default: the runtime config); its window keys are not applied, so pass --window to replay a different spend |
| `--model` | `MODEL` | — | Registered model id replacing each recorded model |
| `--window` | `WINDOW` | — | Prompt spend replacing each recorded spend; candidate window keys are not applied, so this is how to replay a different spend |

### `nexus inspect`

Read-only JSON-first inspection over the NEXUS API.

Verbs: `nexus inspect slot`, `nexus inspect chunks`, `nexus inspect chunk`, `nexus inspect incubator`, `nexus inspect characters`, `nexus inspect places`, `nexus inspect factions`.

### `nexus inspect slot`

Read one slot's state through GET /api/slot/{slot}/state.

Transport: `http`.

| Argument | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--slot` (required) | `SLOT` | — | Slot number (1-5) |

### `nexus inspect chunks`

Read committed chunks: the last N, or an id range.

Transport: `http`.

| Argument | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--slot` (required) | `SLOT` | — | Slot number (1-5) |
| `--last` | `LAST` | — | The newest N committed chunks |
| `--from` | `FROM_ID` | — | First chunk id of the range (default: the first chunk); needs --to |
| `--to` | `TO_ID` | — | Last chunk id of the range; required with --from (alone, the range starts at the first chunk) |

### `nexus continue`

Advance the story.

Transport: `http`.

| Argument | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--slot` (required) | `SLOT` | — | Slot number (1-5) |
| `--choice` | `CHOICE` | — | Select structured choice by number (1-indexed); in narrative mode, with --text, send your edited version of that choice |

| `--weird` | `low`, `medium`, `high` | — | New-story strangeness, saved on the wizard and used by the narrative transition (wizard only) |
